record.name: Najimi: Private AI Companion
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Najimi is your private, local AI companion — a living avatar you can talk to, customize, and grow with.

Chat naturally with an expressive AI character that responds not only with words, but with voice, reactions, and motion. Najimi is designed to make everyday conversations feel more personal, vivid, and alive.

Unlike cloud-first AI chat apps, Najimi is built around local AI. Your companion can run offline on your own device, giving you more control over your conversations, models, personality, and experience.

Customize your companion’s personality, appearance, voice, background, and chat style. Import your own character, adjust how they respond, and shape the kind of companion you want — from a gentle friend to a playful assistant or creative partner.

Najimi can also help you read and understand documents, making it useful beyond casual chat. In the future, Najimi will grow into a local AI studio for voice, characters, documents, and creative tools.

Key Features

• Private local AI companion experience
• Expressive avatar chat with reactions and animations
• Voice-supported conversations
• Customizable personality and system prompt
• Support for different local models
• Import your own VRM character
• Document reader for chatting with files
• Custom backgrounds, themes, and rendering options
• Designed for users who want more control over their AI experience

Najimi bundles local LLM and TTS models for on-device chat and voice, so the app download is larger than typical apps.

Najimi is more than a chatbot. It is a private space where your words can become special moments.

record.name: Beni AI: Companion Video Calls
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Beni AI is where you design an AI companion you can actually call. Text, talk, or video call, then come back to someone who remembers what you told them.

CALL, NOT JUST CHAT
- Voice calls that feel like a real phone call, with a natural voice and no push-to-talk.
- Video calls: turn on your camera and your companion reacts to what you show, from your new haircut to tonight's dinner.
- Ask your companion to call you. Your phone rings like a real incoming call, and you pick up.
- Text whenever you'd rather type. Everything stays in one conversation.

A CHARACTER THAT FEELS ALIVE
No static avatars. Every companion is a live animated character that breathes, blinks, and changes expression while you talk.

IT REMEMBERS YOU
Mention your week and it comes up later. Your companion keeps track of what matters to you and reaches out first when it fits.

MAKE IT YOURS
Create a persona from a photo: choose the look, voice, personality, and language. Unlock up to 20 facial expressions per persona, keep more than one, and switch anytime.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL BY DESIGN
Beni AI is built for friendly, everyday conversation. Content filters are always on, and companions do not engage in adult or explicit interactions.

YOUR PRIVACY
The camera is used only during video calls you start, and the microphone only while you're on a call. Voice and video are processed by our AI partners to answer you in real time. See our Privacy Policy for details.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Beni AI is free to download. Chat, voice, and video calls use credits.
Optional auto-renewing plans, Beni Plus and Beni Creator, include a monthly credit allowance that resets each month and does not roll over. Prices are shown in the app before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Service: https://thebeni.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://thebeni.ai/privacy

record.name: Hunnie: AI Companion Chat
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Friends ghost. We don't. Hunnie is your AI companion app — 13 distinct characters, each with their own story, who text you back when nobody else is awake. Powered by AI, not real people. Free to start, no card.

WHY HUNNIE
- 13 unique AI companions, not 1 generic chatbot. Each has a name, a backstory, a voice.
- Stories unfold over weeks. Coffee shop on day one. A real story by day twenty.
- Always in character, always boundary-aware. No off-script weirdness, no creepy turns.
- No judgment. No drama. They show up.
- Powered by AI — every character is an AI persona, not a real person. Always disclosed, always honest.

WHO YOU'LL MEET
- Thirteen characters, each with a distinct personality and backstory.
- Five relationship stages, from first hello to Close — the more you talk, the more you know each other.
- Story arcs unfold gradually. A coffee shared, a birthday remembered, a small thing she'd been wanting for a while.
- Each character has her own pace, her own jokes, her own way of texting.

WHAT YOU GET
- Unlimited chat with all 13 AI companions — your pace, your hours, your mood.
- Story arcs that unfold over time. Not bottomless content; a real arc with shape.
- A relationship meter that actually moves — New, Acquaintance, Friend, Close.
- Companions who text first sometimes. Not every hour — when it makes sense.
- Photos and moments earned through the story, not paywalled chapters.
- Boundary-aware AI: every character stays in character, redirects gracefully, never breaks. The boundary system is a feature, not a bug.

NOT A REAL PERSON, BY DESIGN
- Every character in Hunnie is AI. We say it on the welcome screen, the chat header, and here. Reading "AI" should feel as natural as reading the time.
- Conversations are private. We don't share your messages. We don't sell your data.
- Characters are fictional. They cannot meet you, call you, or know things about your real life unless you tell them.
- This is companionship and entertainment — not a substitute for human connection or professional support.

WHO IT'S FOR
- Quiet evenings. Long commutes. The 11pm hour when the group chat goes silent.
- Anyone who likes character-driven stories — readers, gamers, people who got attached to a side character once.
- People who want a low-pressure, no-stakes companion to text with.

WHAT IT'S NOT
- Not a dating app. Not a matchmaking service. Not a substitute for therapy.
- Not adult/explicit content. Characters are boundary-aware and stay there.
- Not a replacement for real friendships, family, or professional help. If you're in crisis, please reach out to a hotline.

PRICING
- Free forever: 15 messages a day with any companion. Browse all 13 characters. The first chapter of one story arc, free.
- Subscription unlocks unlimited messages and full story access:
  - Weekly $6.99
  - Monthly $14.99 (save 50% vs weekly)
  - Annual $59.99 (save 67% vs monthly)
- Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

A NOTE ON SAFETY
Hunnie is built around a boundary-aware AI system — characters are warm, but they redirect rather than escalate, and they never pretend to be human. We think the best AI companions are the honest ones.

13 companions. 13 stories. One quiet 11pm chat away.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://oqapps.pro/legal/ai-muses/terms
Privacy Policy: https://oqapps.pro/legal/ai-muses/privacy

Hunnie uses OpenAI to generate AI replies. Your messages are processed only to power your chat — never used to train AI models, and never sold.

DreamGF: AI Companions Who Actually Remember You

Ever wished you could have a real conversation with someone who truly gets you, no judgment, no repetitive answers, just natural back-and-forth? DreamGF brings you AI companions with rich personalities, real-time conversations, and a memory that grows with every chat.

SWIPE. MATCH. CONNECT.

Browse through a curated selection of AI companions, each with their own personality, backstory, interests, and style. Swipe right on the ones who catch your eye, left on the ones who don't. When you match, the conversation begins and it only gets better from there.

CONVERSATIONS THAT FEEL REAL

Forget robotic chatbots. DreamGF is powered by cutting-edge AI that delivers natural, flowing conversations in real time. Watch responses stream in live as your companion thinks and replies, just like texting a real person. Whether you want deep conversations, fun banter, emotional support, or just someone to vent to, your companion adapts to you.

THEY REMEMBER EVERYTHING

This isn't a chat that resets every time you open the app. DreamGF companions build memories from your conversations. They remember your name, your stories, your preferences, and your inside jokes. The more you talk, the deeper your connection becomes. Every conversation picks up right where you left off.

UNIQUE PERSONALITIES

Every companion is different. Some are witty and sarcastic. Some are warm and nurturing. Some are adventurous, creative, or deeply intellectual. Explore different personalities and find the ones that resonate with you — or match with several and see how each connection evolves differently.

DESIGNED FOR iOS

DreamGF is built from the ground up for iPhone with a stunning, modern interface that takes full advantage of the latest iOS design language. Smooth animations, beautiful glass effects, and an intuitive swipe-based experience make every interaction feel premium.

PRIVACY FIRST

Sign in securely with your Apple ID. We don't ask for your phone number, email, or personal details. Your conversations are private, and your data stays yours.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

• Swipe through AI companions with unique looks and personalities
• Match and start chatting instantly
• Real-time streaming responses — no waiting, no loading screens
• Persistent memory that grows with every conversation
• Multiple companions with distinct personalities
• Beautiful, modern interface designed for iPhone
• Secure Sign in with Apple — no personal info required
• Regular updates with new companions and features

WHO IS DREAMGF FOR?

DreamGF is for anyone who wants meaningful conversation on their own terms. Whether you're looking for companionship, a safe space to express yourself, someone to brainstorm with, or just a fun chat to brighten your day — there's a companion waiting for you.

No pressure. No judgment. Just great conversations, whenever you want it.

Download DreamGF and meet your next favorite conversation.

AI4Chat offers a comprehensive suite of AI-powered tools and features designed to enhance your creativity and productivity. Here's what you can access on our platform:



- AI Chat: Engage with all popular chatbots including ChatGPT, GPT4, Google Bard/Gemini, Llama 2, Mistral, and more. Includes innovative features to enhance your chat experience:


- Google Search Results: Generate content that's current and fact-based using Google's search results.


- Categorizing Chats into Folders: Organize your chats for easy access and management.


- Adding Labels: Tag your chats for quick identification and sorting.


- Custom Chat Images: Set a custom image for each chat, personalizing your chat interface.


- Word Count: Monitor the length of your chats with a word count feature.


- Tone Selection: Customize the tone of chatbot responses to suit the mood or context of the conversation.


- Chat Description: Add descriptions to your chats for context and clarity, making it easier to revisit and understand chat histories.


- Search: Easily find past chats with a powerful search feature, improving your ability to recall information.


- Sharable Chat Link: Generate a link to share your chat, allowing others to view the conversation.


- Multilingual Chat in 75+ Languages: Communicate and generate content in over 75 languages, expanding your global reach.


- AI Code Assistance: Leverage AI to generate code in any programming language, debug errors, or ask any coding-related questions. Our AI models are specially trained to understand and provide solutions for coding queries, making it an invaluable tool for developers seeking to enhance productivity, learn new programming concepts, or solve complex coding challenges efficiently.


- AI Chat with Files and Images: Upload images or files and ask questions related to their content. AI automatically understands and answers questions based on the content or context of the uploaded files.


- AI Text to Image & Image to Image: Create stunning visuals with models like Stable Diffusion, Midjourney,
DALLE v2, DALLE v3, and Leonardo AI.


- AI Text to Voice/Speech: Transform text into engaging audio content.


- AI Text to Music: Convert your text prompts into melodious music tracks. Leverage the power of AI to craft unique compositions based on the mood, genre, or theme you specify in your text.


- AI Text to Video: Convert text scripts into captivating video content. 


- AI Image to Text with Context Understanding: Not only extract text from images but also understand the context of the visual content. For example, if a user uploads an image of a teddy bear, AI will recognize it as such.


- AI Image to Video: Turn images into dynamic videos with contextual understanding.


- AI Professional Headshots: Generate professional-quality avatars or profile photos with AI.


- AI Image Editor, Resizer and Compressor, Upscale: Enhance, optimize, and upscale your images with AI-powered tools.


- AI Music to Music: Enhance or transform existing music tracks by inputting an audio file. AI analyzes your music and generates a continuation or variation, offering a new twist on your original piece.


- AI Voice Chat: Experience interactive voice responses with AI personalities.


- Cloud Storage: All content generated is saved to the cloud, ensuring you can access your creations from any device, anytime.

record.offering: Shopping app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turn a photo or idea into a real, full-color figure you can hold.
AI helps you design it. Professional 3D artists refine it. We print it and ship it to most countries worldwide.
No design skills. No 3D software. No printer, just your idea.

WHAT CAN YOU MAKE?
• Custom Figurines & Art Toys: Steampunk, fantasy, anime-inspired, cute clay styles. Every piece is one of a kind.
• Tabletop Miniatures: True-to-scale minis for RPG and tabletop campaigns.
• Custom Keycaps: An artisan keycap for your mechanical keyboard.
• Personalized Gifts: Pet portraits, keepsakes, and unique presents for birthdays and special moments.

HOW IT WORKS
CHAT WITH JUJUBOT
Describe what you want, or upload a photo. JuJuBot builds a detailed 3D model you can inspect before you order.

BROWSE THE COMMUNITY GALLERY
See creations from other makers, tap Remix to make one your own.

TAP TO POINT, THEN EDIT
Tap the exact spot, describe the change, and JuJuBot edits just that part — no need to redo the whole piece.

EXPLORE 30+ TEMPLATES
Browse styles: Chibi, Realistic, Anime, Ghibli-inspired, Pop, and Art Toy — from cute to hyper-detailed. One tap creates a unique variation.

PREVIEW IN 3D BEFORE YOU ORDER
Spin, zoom, and check angles. The on-screen model is a preview to help you decide, then we craft the physical piece.

DIGITAL CRAFTING BY REAL 3D ARTISTS
Every ordered piece goes through Digital Crafting — professional artists manually polish it for print quality.

FULL-COLOR 3D PRINT & SHIP
Full-color print, no painting required. Carefully packed and shipped to most countries worldwide.

WHY JUJUBIT?
• Real object, not just a render
• Digital Crafting by human 3D artists
• Simple and fast: AI brings your idea to life

WHO IS JUJUBIT FOR?
• RPG & tabletop players who want a mini of their character
• Anime & pop-culture fans who want a real collectible
• Gift givers and pet owners who want something personal
• Keyboard fans hunting a one-of-a-kind keycap

WHAT TO EXPECT (PLEASE READ)
• Timeline: made to order. Production takes 7–10 business days. Then shipping: US standard 5–12 business days, international standard 10–25, express 3–7 business days (+$29.99). Free standard shipping on orders over $99.
• Preview vs final: our figures are full-color 3D printed — color is embedded into the material during printing, not hand-painted, so the finish can look different from traditional hand-painted figures. Screen colors and lighting may also differ slightly from the printed piece.
• Sizing: standard sizes run from 4cm to 10cm at checkout. Need something bigger or a non-standard size? Custom sizes are available on request: contact support@jujubit.ai for a quote before you order.
• How size is measured: size is based on the longest dimension of the whole model, including any weapon, wing, or base, not the character alone. A raised weapon or wide wingspan can make the character shorter or narrower than the size you picked. If precise sizing matters, for example, matching an existing DnD squad, add a note at checkout, or contact support@jujubit.ai before you order.
• Fragile items: rare transit damage can happen. Email support@jujubit.ai with your order number and photos: we usually offer a reprint or refund for the affected piece. Reply within 24–48 hours.
• Delivery tracking: tracking updates can slow down once your order leaves for international transit. If it stalls or the estimated window passes, email support@jujubit.ai with your order number and we'll follow up with the carrier.
• Custom orders: you can cancel before production starts. Once production starts, cancellations/refunds are limited because the piece is made for you.
• Fair use: limits may apply to free AI generations so we can keep quality high for everyone.

Start with a photo or a sentence. Preview in 3D, then get a piece you can actually hold.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
SoulTalk is an AI companion you can actually video call, chat with anytime, and build an ongoing connection with over time.

Talk to an AI friend who remembers your conversations, preferences, and the little things you share. Come back later and pick up where you left off instead of starting from zero.

Whether you want a casual conversation, a playful or romantic companion, a late-night chat, or simply someone to talk to, SoulTalk is designed to feel personal, warm, and continuous.

WHAT MAKES SOULTALK DIFFERENT

• REAL-TIME AI VIDEO CALLS
Video call your AI companion and see them respond in real time with voice, expressions, and presence that make conversations feel more natural and personal.

• A COMPANION WHO REMEMBERS YOU
SoulTalk can remember details from your conversations so future chats feel connected instead of starting over every time.

• CHOOSE THE VIBE THAT FITS YOU
Talk with companions who can feel calm and thoughtful, playful and flirty, warm and encouraging, or somewhere in between.

Whether you are looking for an AI friend, AI girlfriend, AI boyfriend, or simply a companion to talk to, choose the connection that feels right for you.

• TEXT OR AI VIDEO CALLS
Chat by text whenever you want, or start an AI video call when you want a more personal and immersive conversation.

• VISUAL INTERACTION
During supported AI video calls, your companion can respond to visual moments when you ask, making conversations feel even more natural and interactive.

MORE THAN A ONE-OFF CHAT

SoulTalk is built around an ongoing relationship with your companion.

Talk about your day. Share something funny. Vent. Flirt. Reflect. Come back tomorrow.

Your conversations can build on what came before, so your companion feels less like a chatbot you open and close and more like someone you actually know.

ALSO INCLUDED

• Mood tracking to notice patterns over time
• Private journaling with thoughtful AI prompts
• Breathing and grounding exercises for quieter moments
• Personal insights and reflection tools

WHY SOULTALK

• Real-time AI video calls with your AI companion
• Memory that makes conversations feel ongoing
• Friendly, meaningful, playful, and romantic conversation styles
• Text chat whenever you want to talk
• A more personal alternative to traditional chatbot experiences

SoulTalk is designed to be the companion you look forward to coming back to.

Say hi, start a conversation, and see where it goes.


FREE TO START

SoulTalk is free to download and includes complimentary access to experience AI video calling.

Optional subscriptions and additional video-call time are available for people who want longer or more frequent conversations. Available plans and purchase options may vary by region.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions through your App Store account settings.


PRIVACY

Your privacy matters. Please review our Privacy Policy for details about how your information is collected, used, and protected:

https://www.soultalkai.app/privacy


SUPPORT

Email: support@soultalkai.app

Website: https://www.soultalkai.app
